name: Sandcastle
description: Open-source AFK coding agent orchestration framework by Matt Pocock. Creates git worktrees, runs sandboxed coding agents in Docker, parallelizes tasks, merges code. 889 commits, described as 'none hand-coded'. Supports making the sandbox pluggable (local or remote).

name: Conductor
description: macOS app for running multiple AI coding agents (primarily Claude Code instances) in parallel within isolated git worktree workspaces. Built by Jackson de Campos and Charlie Holtz (San Francisco). Provides real-time visibility into agent progress, diff review, GitHub sync for inline comments. v0.29 shipped Jan 7 2026.

name: paper.design
description: Code-native design tool built on a fluid canvas where everything runs on real React and Tailwind. Designers can import production design systems, use animated shaders, and export flex layouts as production-ready components. Founded by Stephen Haney (ex-Modulz, Radix UI).

name: gstack
description: Garry Tan's open-source Claude Code configuration: 23 specialist skills and 8 power tools packaged as slash commands. Turns Claude Code into a virtual engineering team (CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, QA roles). Viral on release (March 2026): 16k+ stars, 9100+ forks. MIT licensed, v0.15.14 as of April 2026.

name: gbrain
description: Garry Tan's persistent agent knowledge base for AI agents — powers his OpenClaw/Hermes deployments. Provides cross-session memory that agents actually keep between sessions. 17,888 pages, 4,383 people, 723 companies created in 12 days of use.

name: claude-code-transcripts
description: Python CLI tool by Simon Willison for converting Claude Code session files (JSONL from ~/.claude/projects/ or JSON from Claude Code for web) into browseable multi-page HTML transcripts. Supports --gist flag to auto-publish to GitHub Gist with shareable gistpreview.github.io URL. Published December 25 2025.

name: Vibe Kanban
description: Open-source kanban-based orchestration dashboard for AI coding agents. Built with Rust + TypeScript by BloopAI. Supports 10+ coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Amp, Cursor, OpenCode, etc.). Provides planning, parallel agent execution, diff review, and built-in browser preview. 14.7k+ stars.

name: Ruflo (Claude Flow)
description: Multi-agent orchestration platform for Claude. Deploys intelligent agent swarms with self-learning memory, RAG integration, federated cross-machine comms, and WASM/Rust policy engine. Renamed from claude-flow in Jan 2026 to avoid trademark issues. v3.6 shipped April 29 2026 with 314 native MCP tools.

name: Playwright MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol server that exposes Playwright browser automation to AI agents (Claude Code, Cline, Cursor, etc.). Enables navigate, click, type, screenshot, evaluate, and wait_for_selector from within Claude Code sessions. Community standard for AI-driven browser testing and visual verification. Microsoft Playwright CLI companion released early 2026 as lower-token alternative.

name: awesome-claude-code (hesreallyhim)
description: Community-curated list of skills, hooks, slash-commands, agent orchestrators, applications, and plugins for Claude Code. One of several 'awesome' lists — this one focused on curated quality over quantity.

name: LLM Wiki (Karpathy pattern)
description: Andrej Karpathy's GitHub Gist describing a pattern for building LLM-maintained personal knowledge bases using structured markdown files. Three-layer architecture: raw/ (immutable source), wiki/ (LLM-maintained markdown with cross-references), schema/ (config directing agent behavior). Published April 4 2026. Hit 27,900 stars. Spawned numerous open-source implementations (lucasastorian/llmwiki, kfchou/wiki-skills, etc.).

name: DESIGN.md (Google Labs format spec)
description: Open format spec by Google Labs (from Google Stitch) for expressing design systems in a single markdown file. YAML front matter holds design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, component states); markdown prose holds rationale. AI agents read it as persistent context. CLI (npx @google/design.md) lints for WCAG AA contrast and exports to Tailwind or W3C DTCG tokens.json. Released April 21, 2026. 11.6k+ stars. Sits alongside CLAUDE.md and SKILL.md as the third governance layer for UI. Recommended pattern: CLAUDE.md (behavioral rules) + DESIGN.md (visual rules) + SKILL.md (procedures).

name: designmd.ai + awesome-design-md (VoltAgent)
description: Community hub and curated library of 100+ pre-built DESIGN.md files for popular brands/systems, built by VoltAgent (Necati Özmen + Omer Aplak). awesome-design-md has 71k+ stars. Also has an MCP server for direct agent integration without manual file downloads. VoltAgent also maintains awesome-claude-code-subagents (19k+ stars, 100+ Claude subagents) and awesome-agent-skills (20k+ stars, 1000+ agent skills).

name: VoltAgent
description: Open-source TypeScript AI agent framework by Necati Özmen and Omer Aplak (ex-Refine.js / YC S23). 8.6k+ stars. Complements their awesome-* community repos.

name: awesome-claude-code-subagents (VoltAgent)
description: Curated list of 100+ Claude Code subagent profiles by VoltAgent. 19k+ stars. Complements hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code (skills/hooks focus) with a subagent-persona focus.

name: awesome-claude-skills (ComposioHQ)
description: Curated list of Claude Skills, resources, and tools by Composio. 58k+ stars — the largest Claude skills repo by stars. Covers content creation, dev automation, orchestration skills. Community contributions across 1000+ skills.

name: OpenClaw
description: Open-source AI agent framework created by Peter Steinberger (founder/ex-CEO of PSPDFKit). Originally ClawdBot/MoltBook — hit 100K GitHub stars by Feb 2026, one of fastest-growing OS repos ever. Now managed by a foundation after Steinberger joined OpenAI. Personal AI assistant for any OS/platform.

name: Dagger container-use
description: Open-sourced by Solomon Hykes at AIEWF 2025. Containerized environments for coding agents — isolates Claude Code, Goose, and other agents in containers for safe parallel execution. Dagger is Solomon's company post-Docker.

name: tldraw computer
description: AI workflows app on an infinite canvas by Steve Ruiz / tldraw. Agents work spatially on a canvas. Series: Make Real (2023, first vibe coding tool), tldraw computer (2024), Fairydraw (2025). Relevant to both design tooling and unified project layer concepts.

name: Intent (Augment Code)
description: Developer workspace for orchestrating AI coding agents. Built by Amelia Wattenberger at Augment Code. Addresses the 'last 30%' problem — the hardest parts of any software project. Most relevant to the unified-project-layer pain point.

name: Mastra (TypeScript agent framework)
description: TypeScript-native agent framework supporting both agents and workflows ('Agents vs Workflows: Why Not Both?'). Used by WorkOS for AI Pipelines in Pure TypeScript. Discussed at AIEWF 2025.

name: Figma Make
description: Figma's AI-powered tool for generating UI from text prompts. Produces editable Figma designs directly, bridging the gap between prompt and production-ready component layout.

name: Claude Design (claude.ai/design)
description: Anthropic's dedicated design interface within Claude — generates UI mockups and component designs from prompts. Outputs design artifacts that can be handed off to Claude Code for implementation.

name: andrej-karpathy-skills CLAUDE.md
description: Community-created CLAUDE.md by Forrest Chang, synthesized from Andrej Karpathy's public observations about how he uses Claude Code. Not authored by Karpathy directly — Karpathy has no published CLAUDE.md in his own repos. Reference value: shows how a prominent AI practitioner's workflow preferences translate into instruction form.

name: awesome-claude-code-toolkit (rohitg00)
description: Comprehensive toolkit: 135 agents, 35 curated skills (+400k via SkillKit), 42 commands, 176+ plugins, 20 hooks, 15 rules, 7 templates, 14 MCP configs, 26 companion apps. Anthropic x Forum Ventures hackathon winner. 1.5k stars.

name: Caveman
description: Claude Code skill (and cross-agent plugin) that enforces terse, telegraphic prompting to cut output tokens ~65% (range 22-87% across tasks). Three intensity tiers (Lite / Full / Ultra) plus Classical Chinese mode. Bundled subagents (cavecrew) for investigate/build/review, an MCP middleware (caveman-shrink) that compresses tool descriptions, and caveman-stats for live session-savings tracking. v1.7.0 May 2026 added smart installer and stats receipts. Detects 30+ agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.). Pairs with the author's cavemem (cross-agent memory) and cavekit (spec-driven build automation). Cites a March 2026 paper finding constrained brief responses improved accuracy by 26pp on certain benchmarks.

name: agent-skills (Addy Osmani)
description: Addy Osmani's open-source skill bundle covering the production SDLC for AI coding agents: Define -> Plan -> Build -> Verify -> Review -> Ship. Bundles reusable personas (code-reviewer, test-engineer, etc.) as drop-in SKILL.md files. Created Feb 2026, surged Mar-May. Drop into any Claude Code project's skills/ directory for a full-lifecycle workflow.

name: skills (Matt Pocock)
description: Matt Pocock's personal Claude Code .claude/ directory, published as 17 production-ready skills: /grill-me (design stress-testing), /write-a-prd, /write-issues, git-guardrails-claude-code (blocks dangerous git commands), and more. TypeScript-flavored. The canonical reference for what an opinionated solo-practitioner skills folder looks like.

name: claude-context (Zilliz)
description: MCP server from the Milvus team that combines BM25 keyword search + dense vector search with AST-aware code chunking. ~40% token reduction on large-codebase queries. Lets Claude Code subscription users work efficiently across web app monorepos without blowing the context window.

name: design-extract
description: Created Apr 2026 by Manavarya09. Extracts a live website's design system into DTCG tokens, Tailwind v4 config, shadcn/ui components, and Figma variables — using Playwright under the hood. Ships as an MCP server for Claude Code. Bridge from 'I like that site's design' to working tokens/Tailwind config in your project. Directly addresses the design-tooling pain point.

name: agents (wshobson)
description: Pre-built subagent team for full-stack web app delivery: backend-architect, database-architect, frontend-developer, test-automator, security-auditor, deployment-engineer. Drop-in personas for the multi-agent-orchestration topic. One of the most-starred subagent collections.

name: Archon
description: Open-source 'harness builder' that aims to make AI coding deterministic and repeatable across runs. Reproducibility layer over Claude Code/Codex. Aligns with the harness-engineering thesis (Lopopolo, Kumar) — packages it as a usable tool.

name: claude-code-hooks-mastery
description: Reference implementation for all 12 Claude Code hook lifecycle events with build/validate orchestration patterns. Most-cited hooks tutorial. Direct fit for the repo-template-governance hooks sub-section.

name: lean-ctx
description: Created Mar 2026 by yvgude. 'Context OS' — a Rust binary plus MCP server that ships shell hooks, 49 tools, 10 read modes, and 90+ patterns for cutting Claude Code token waste 60-95%. Alternative philosophy to caveman: optimize the read pipeline rather than the prompt style.

name: harness (revfactory)
description: Created Mar 2026. Meta-skill that designs domain-specific agent teams and generates the skills they use. Lets you bootstrap a project-specific Claude Code setup by describing the project, instead of curating skills manually. Operationalizes the 'harness engineering' framing as a generator.

name: Open Design (nexu-io)
description: Local-first, open-source alternative to Anthropic's Claude Design. Auto-detects 15+ coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, Codex, OpenCode, Qwen, Hermes, Kimi CLI, etc.) and uses them as interchangeable design engines — BYOK, no subscription. Ships 129 portable design systems as DESIGN.md files (Linear, Stripe, Vercel, Notion, Apple, etc.) plus 31 SKILL.md skills. Local Express + SQLite daemon spawns the chosen agent with real filesystem access; web UI is Next.js, optional Electron desktop. Exposes a stdio MCP server so Claude Code in any other repo can query live design tokens / CSS / components without re-export cycles. Apache-2.0. Maintained by the nexu.io org (also publishes a 'harness-engineering-guide').

name: arize/prompt-learning
description: SDK and CLI for optimizing LLM prompts using natural-language critiques as the error signal (not numeric scores). Observe → Evaluate → Improve loop that rewrites only the fenced instruction block of a system prompt.
